linked_prs.title: Add Alpha Vantage API Integration and Refactor Data Provider Architecture
linked_prs.body:
## Summary

This PR adds Alpha Vantage as an alternative data provider while maintaining yfinance and OpenAI as the default vendors. It also performs a major refactoring of the data provider architecture to improve modularity and maintainability.

## Changes

### Alpha Vantage Integration
- **Add Alpha Vantage as alternative data vendor** with comprehensive API support
- **Implement comprehensive Alpha Vantage modules:**
  - Stock data (daily OHLCV with date filtering)
  - Technical indicators (SMA, EMA, MACD, RSI, Bollinger Bands, ATR)
  - Fundamental data (overview, balance sheet, cashflow, income statement)
  - News and sentiment data with insider transactions
- **Update documentation** to include Alpha Vantage configuration alongside existing vendors
- **Integrate Alpha Vantage vendor methods** into interface routing
- **Maintain yfinance and OpenAI as default vendors** with full backward compatibility

### Architecture Refactoring
- **Major refactoring of data provider interface** (943 lines removed, streamlined)
- **Extracted specialized utility modules** from monolithic `agent_utils.py`:
  - `core_stock_tools.py` - Core stock data operations
  - `fundamental_data_tools.py` - Fundamental analysis tools
  - `news_data_tools.py` - News and sentiment analysis tools
  - `technical_indicators_tools.py` - Technical analysis tools
- **Added new data provider modules:**
  - `alpha_vantage.py` - Alpha Vantage API integration
  - `local.py` - Local data provider implementation
  - `openai.py` - OpenAI integration
  - `google.py` - Google data provider
  - `y_finance.py` - Enhanced Yahoo Finance provider
- **Updated all analyst modules** to use new modular tool structure
- **Improved CLI and configuration** with better default settings

## Test Plan
- [x] Verify Alpha Vantage API integration works with valid API key
- [x] Test all technical indicators return expected data
- [x] Confirm fundamental data retrieval functions correctly
- [x] Validate news and sentiment analysis features
- [x] Ensure backward compatibility with existing vendor system
- [x] Test all analyst modules with new modular tool structure
- [x] Verify CLI functionality with updated configuration
